_comment: 🎨️ SVG 1.1/✳️basic's own contribution to the repository test platform: `quick-xml` 0.42 registered as the independent reference reader/writer for THIS subset's own 11-kind `SvgBasicMutation` vocabulary, and the comparison profile that vocabulary is measured under. A distinct id and capability from the sibling `✳️any` and `✳️tiny` registrations, for the same reason those two are distinct from each other.

oracles.rationale: quick-xml is a general streaming XML reader AND writer, not an SVG library and not a profile validator. This subset's oracle (../🧪️oracle/🦀️component.rs) builds its own element tree from quick-xml's event stream through the shared 📰markup family module, resolves clip-path url(#id) references and applies the profile's clip-to-text and excluded-raster-primitive rules from its own transcription of REC-SVGMobile-20030114, and re-serializes with quick-xml's Writer. It never imports this repository's own SVG codec or its check_svg_basic_conformance.

comparisonProfiles.description: SVG Basic 1.1 mutation round trips compared structurally: element/text/CDATA/comment/PI tree shape and content exact, attributes compared as a name-sorted set (attribute order is real writer freedom), and the viewBox/transform attribute values decomposed into typed numeric geometry rather than compared as raw strings, with a small absolute tolerance for cross-implementation float formatting. The clip-path attribute is deliberately NOT decomposed and NOT ignored: its exact url(#id) string is what the profile's clip-to-text rule is evaluated against, so it is compared verbatim. Self-closing versus explicit empty open/close tags are equivalent by construction and never distinguished by either side.
